column1: # Route steps for route hints, in the order the game opens them.
# Written for this project from our own knowledge of the game, in our own words; "way in" is terse: from -> do. The structure follows the game's
#   own data: one step per area (the place names of data/region_areas.tsv), split only where the game gates part of
#   an area behind a boss (the Dancer's return to High Wall; the Ringed City past Halflight, where Gael's fight is a
#   map of its own, m51_01). Each step's bosses are where the game's map files put them (data/bosses.tsv's areas).
# Facts kept: the boss defeat flags (data/bosses.tsv). The data tests check every flag, area and boss against the
#   other tables, that every step can be reached, and that boss required / optional agrees with the gates.
# Columns: id <TAB> area <TAB> kind (main / optional / dlc) <TAB> needs <TAB> from <TAB> bosses <TAB> way in
#   needs: space-separated groups, ALL must hold; a group is alternatives split by '|'; an alternative is a
#          boss flag (defeated) or "Nof:flag,flag,..." (at least N of them defeated); "-" = open from the start.
#   from:  the area the way in starts from ("-" for the first).
#   bosses: defeat flags of this step's bosses, comma-separated ("-" for none). A step is done when all of
#           them are defeated (optional bosses included); a step without bosses is done once it's open.
# Lords of Cinder: Abyss Watchers 13300800, Yhorm the Giant 13900800, Aldrich 13700800, the Twin Princes 13410830.
# Killing Emma early also brings the Dancer forward; no flag for that is used here.
